# WH19 · Ask Pema · không có ảnh chờ xem

Group **WH · Ask Pema & Hướng dẫn** · state · Next.js: **built (U7)** (`/ask`) · account `owner-tam`

## Logic source
- Old web: `prototype/shared/clinic.js#action`
- "Ask Pema" is `clinic.js › ask()` (a scripted query over the demo state, no model); the guide is `guide.js` (`PemaGuide.render()` and its navigation).
- `clinic.js › ask()` draws the page; `action('ask')` is a scripted query over the demo state (no model): it builds the sentence in `result`, writes it into `#ask-result` and adds "Mở dữ liệu nguồn →" (`data-nav` followups for image questions, patients otherwise).
- After the open follow-ups with an image are answered and closed in "Theo dõi" (filter "image", `data-action="view-followup"`, then `review-submit`; capability `clinical`), the image question counts none: "Có 0 ảnh chờ xem: Không có. Nguồn: Follow-up Inbox, status=open, có ảnh."
- Inventory note: After the two image follow-ups are closed the answer reads "Có 0 ảnh chờ xem: Không có. Nguồn: Follow-up Inbox, status=open, có ảnh."
- Page key `followups` is allowed for roles: owner, doctor (`staff-context.js` › pages). Shown here with account `owner-tam`.
- Capabilities (`staff-context.js` › capabilities): clinical: owner/doctor; crm: owner/care/doctor; booking: owner/care/doctor; billing: owner/accountant; config: owner; readFinance: owner/accountant/doctor.
- No control on this screen is removed by a capability check.
- How to reach it in the old web: {"goto":"/clinic-web/?staff={role}"} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"followups\"]"} → {"click":"[data-followup-filter=\"image\"]"} → {"ifVisible":["[data-action=\"view-followup\"]",[{"click":"[data-action=\"view-followup\"]"},{"wait":"#review-reply"},{"click":"[data-action=\"review-submit\"]"},{"wait":".page-title"}]]} → {"ifVisible":["[data-action=\"view-followup\"]",[{"click":"[data-action=\"view-followup\"]"},{"wait":"#review-reply"},{"click":"[data-action=\"review-submit\"]"},{"wait":".page-title"}]]} → {"click":".sidebar [data-nav=\"ask\"]"} → {"click":"[data-question=\"Ai có ảnh gửi sau laser đang chờ xem?\"]"} → {"click":"[data-action=\"ask\"]"} → {"wait":"#ask-result"}; it must show "Không có".

## Layout (top to bottom, region → src/ui component)
Every field, action, status, filter and text of the old screen is listed; rows and cards that repeat show the first one with demo values and their count. `old="…"` is the old CSS class, `// key=value` the old `data-*` hook that carries the behaviour.
```tsx
<AppShell role="owner-tam">  // sidebar and top bar are the same on every page (WA1-WA3); active menu item "Ask Pema", page key "ask"
  <PageHeading eyebrow="Pema Digital Clinic" title="Ask Pema" subtitle="Bộ truy vấn mô phỏng trên 46 hồ sơ tổng hợp · chưa tích hợp mô hình AI.">
    <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Gợi ý câu hỏi"</Button>  // action=ask-sample
  </PageHeading>
  <Grid old="grid grid-2" cols="minmax(0px, 1.45fr) minmax(0px, 1fr)" gap="24px">
    <Card old="panel" title="Bạn muốn biết điều gì?" subtitle="Pema hiển thị nguồn dữ liệu và câu trả lời có thể kiểm tra lại.">
      <Row old="search-box" gap="12px">
        <Text>"✦"</Text>
        <Field type="text" placeholder="Ví dụ: Ai quá hạn tái khám hơn 30 ngày?" default="Ai có ảnh gửi sau laser đang chờ xem?" id="ask-input" />
        <Button variant="primary" old="btn btn-primary">"Hỏi"</Button>  // action=ask
      </Row>
      <Row old="filter-row" gap="8px" wrap>
        <FilterChipGroup items={["Ảnh chờ xem","Kế hoạch đang chạy","Quá hạn tái khám"]} selected={[]} />  // question
      </Row>
    </Card>
    <Card old="ai-card">
      <Eyebrow>"Kết quả mô phỏng · có thể kiểm tra"</Eyebrow> /* uppercase */
      <Heading level={3}>"Ai có ảnh gửi sau laser đang chờ xem?"</Heading>
      <Text>"Có 0 ảnh chờ xem: Không có. Nguồn: Follow-up Inbox, status=open, có ảnh."</Text>
      <Button variant="secondary" old="btn">"Mở dữ liệu nguồn →"</Button>  // nav=followups
    </Card>
  </Grid>
  <Notice tone="info" old="toast">"Đã gửi phản hồi và đóng mục theo dõi"</Notice>
</AppShell>
```
Kit components used: Button×3, Card×2, PageHeading×1, Field×1; shared pieces: FilterChip×1, Notice×1. Everything else (Row, Grid, Stack, Text, Heading, Progress, Avatar, Facts, Repeat, Cell…) is a plain element styled with tokens; W3 turns the recurring ones into web blocks.

## Differences from the app design
- App I12 lists two patient tiles for the same question ("2 ảnh chờ bác sĩ xem"); the empty answer is not drawn there.
- (generated) Notice of the old web not found verbatim in I12: "Đã gửi phản hồi và đóng mục theo dõi"

## Gotchas
- The toast "Đã gửi phản hồi và đóng mục theo dõi" (2800 ms) of the last follow-up may still be on the page in the snapshot.
- The reach repeats the close step twice with `ifVisible`, so it works whether one or two image follow-ups are open.
